verdict.rationale: A hands-on community report says you can download vue(.min).js and be ready to go with no package manager or bundler [vue-comm-6]. Others describe sprinkling Vue into existing templates [vue-comm-4], which fits the vendor's 'incrementally adoptable' and 'standard HTML, CSS and JavaScript' claims [vue-docs-2, vue-docs-3]. One complaint about build-tool dependency [vue-comm-16] concerns full app builds and does not contradict script-tag use. Missing for 10: first-party docs explicitly describing CDN/script-tag usage, and recent independent corroboration that it works with the current version.
